name: Power Overwhelming

angles.text: As an ally of the Kirin Tor, you know Stormwind is eager to strengthen its bond by aiding Dalaran as it rebuilds.
As a mage, you know the Kirin Tor share a kinship with your calling, and that unstable arcane manifestations endanger Dalaran.

faq.answer: High Sorcerer Andromath sends aid from Stormwind as the Kirin Tor rebuild Dalaran. A Mana Elemental formed from wayward arcane energy threatens their work.
faq.q: What is the quest Power Overwhelming?

faq.answer: High Sorcerer Andromath asks champions in Stormwind City to journey to Dalaran and aid the Kirin Tor.
Archimonde devastated Dalaran during the Third War. As the Kirin Tor rebuild their home, its surviving magi remain wary of outsiders.
faq.q: Why is Dalaran reclusive and distrusting?

aliases: why are there mana elementals in dalaran
what is going on in dalaran
faq.answer: Volatile arcane energy has surged out of control during Dalaran’s reconstruction and formed hostile mana elementals.
faq.q: What is causing the disturbance in Dalaran?

faq.answer: A Mana Elemental is a being formed from pure mana. Its appearance shows the arcane disturbance threatening Dalaran is stronger than first reports suggested.

aliases: why does alliance care about dalaran
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. High Sorcerer Andromath sends aid because he fears Dalaran could fall to chaos or leave the Alliance while vulnerable.
faq.q: Why is Stormwind sending help to Dalaran?

sections.body: After Archimonde destroyed Dalaran in the Third War, the Kirin Tor drew inward. Scholars and sorcerers once came from across the world to its doors. Now the surviving magi keep outsiders away as they rebuild their ruined city behind closed borders.
sections.title: A City in Seclusion

sections.body: As the Kirin Tor restore Dalaran, arcane energy has grown dangerous. Volatile leaks surge out of control and take shape as beings of pure mana. High Sorcerer Andromath fears internal turmoil could undo the city’s recovery, or that Dalaran could abandon its old ties to the Alliance. So he sends champions from Stormwind to quell the Mana Elemental and remind the Kirin Tor that their allies still stand with them.
sections.title: Wayward Arcane Forces

summary: High Sorcerer Andromath sends aid from Stormwind to Dalaran, where arcane power has turned dangerous. The Kirin Tor rebuild behind closed borders, and a Mana Elemental threatens their work.
